Cake-ya San Monogatari - Oishii Sweets o.name: Cake Yasan Monogatari Oishii Sweet wo Tsukurou!
Cake-ya San Monogatari - Oishii Sweets o.summary:
Play as a novice patisserie and work at a cake shop in a town, gaining experience while learning various sweets recipes from the store manager, and grows into a full-fledged patisserie.

The game contains 50 recipes for sweets that you can make. In addition, you can enjoy dress-up and interior coordination.

Jewel Master - Cradle of Rome 2.name: Jewel Master: Cradle of Rome 2
Jewel Master - Cradle of Rome 2.summary:
Rebuild the all-conquering Roman Empire - in 3D! The best-selling Jewel Master series comes to the 3DS with its most successful brand to date - Cradle of Rome.

Welcome back to Rome, where you are given powers of the greatest Emperor ever and are tasked with rebuilding this great civilization. Swap tiles to create matches of three or more identical tiles to gather gold and resources. The more you collect the faster you can erect beautiful houses and magnificent palaces.

• 100 levels of addictive match-3 gameplay
• Collect resources such as wood, food and gold
• The more you collect, the faster Rome is built
• Obtain special power-ups to aid your progress through difficult stages
• The best-selling match-3 series now presented in glorious 3D

Luv Me Buddies Wonderland.name: Luv Me Buddies Wonderland
Luv Me Buddies Wonderland.summary: Play and have fun with the fantastic Luv Me Buddies puppets and experience an exciting adventure along with your nice, new friends!

Skylanders - Spyro no Daibouken.name: Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure
Skylanders - Spyro no Daibouken.summary:
Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure is the first video game in the Skylanders series. It is a video game that is played along with toy figures that interact with it through a "Portal of Power", that reads their tag through NFC and features the voices of Josh Keaton, Dave Wittenberg, Darin De Paul, Joey Camen, Audrey Wasilewski, Keythe Farley and Kevin Michael Richardson.

The 3DS ports of the first four Skylanders games are completely different from their home console counterparts in terms of gameplay and story.

Story of Seasons - Trio of Towns.name: Story of Seasons: Trio of Towns
Story of Seasons - Trio of Towns.summary:
The series is celebrating its 20th anniversary with a new game for the Nintendo 3DS. The title of the game is Bokujō Monogatari: Mitsu no Sato no Taisetsu na Tomodachi (Harvest Moon/Story of Seasons: Precious Friends From Three Villages).

The game will have at least three locales: Lulucoco Town, Tsuyukusa Village and Wes Town. The culture of each will be completely different. Lulucoco is an island settlement, Tsuyukusa is a Japanese village, and Wes Town is a western-style town.

The game will feature a protagonist - female or male - and the characters Noel, Miranda, Megan, and Frank from Wes Town.
